releaseNote.summary: A June 29 hotfix shipped the priority Slack and stability fixes to prod, including the dropped-reply / internal-formatting-error fix. The full r46 release is still in draft; its remaining items will follow when it ships.
releaseNote.plannedWindow: The priority subset is live (June 29 hotfix). The full r46 release is still in draft; its window is not confirmed yet and will be posted once set.
releaseNote.details: Shipped June 29 (direct hotfix): the occasional dropped Slack reply / internal formatting error is fixed, Slack permissions are narrowed (Runneth only reads channels it is added to and no longer self-joins, existing installs should reinstall), Slack channel setup prompts are aligned, automatic channel discovery is stopped, a missing video transcript no longer errors a Meta or TikTok pull, large conversations no longer choke on big event files, and VM creation recovers on its own when a token callback fails. The broader r46 release (package manager, GLM 5.2 model, Runneth CLI chat mode, Hims custom conversions, Northbeam routing, and more) is still in draft and will ship separately.
releaseNote.statusPagePlacement: Show the next planned release with Recent Releases, alongside the upcoming release entry.

notices.summary: Fixed: the occasional dropped Slack reply (internal formatting error).
notices.impact: Runneth would sometimes skip its Slack reply and, in some cases, post "I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response. Please try again." instead of answering. This is now fixed and live.
notices.workaround: None needed. If you saw a dropped reply or that error before, it should no longer happen.

resolution.label: Fixed and live
resolution.note: The remaining edge case (PDEC-8349) shipped in the June 29 hotfix, so the dropped-reply / internal-formatting-error issue is fully resolved. Earlier fixes shipped June 11 (r38) and June 19 (r41).

notices.statusPageGuidance: Resolved. The occasional dropped Slack reply and the "internal formatting error" message are fixed as of the June 29 hotfix.
notices.runnethTrigger: User asks about or reports an 'internal formatting response' error in Slack, or Runneth posting an error line after being told to stop.
notices.runnethGuidance: The dropped Slack reply and the "internal formatting error" message are resolved as of the June 29 hotfix (PDEC-8349), following earlier fixes on June 11 and June 19. If someone reports seeing it before that, the fix is now live. Do not raise this proactively.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the Slack thread link and whether Runneth had started responding before the error appeared.
notices.errorQuote: I hit an internal formatting error while preparing this Slack response. Please try again.

notices.summary: Some customers can't connect Slack until their Slack admin changes a setting.
notices.impact: If a customer's Slack workspace only allows apps from the Slack Marketplace, connecting Runneth to Slack will fail. It looks like a Runneth bug, but it is a setting on the customer's own Slack workspace.
notices.workaround: Before filing a Slack connection bug, have the customer's Slack admin open their Slack settings, go to Manage apps, then App Management Settings. Under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace', click Edit and make sure 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed' is unchecked. Then try connecting again.

resolution.label: Customer-side Slack setting
resolution.note: This is a setting in the customer's own Slack workspace, not a Runneth bug. Once their Slack admin allows apps from outside the Slack Marketplace, the connection works.

notices.statusPageGuidance: Slack connection failures are often a customer-side Slack setting. Have the customer's Slack admin go to Manage apps, then App Management Settings, and uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed' under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' before reporting a bug.
notices.runnethTrigger: User reports that a customer cannot connect Slack, that Slack connection is failing, or asks about Slack connect errors during onboarding.
notices.runnethGuidance: If someone reports a customer cannot connect Slack, point to the customer-side Slack setting first: their Slack admin should go to Slack settings, Manage apps, App Management Settings, and under 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed', then retry. Treat this as a likely cause before filing a Runneth bug. Do not raise proactively for normal Slack requests.
notices.supportGuidance: Capture the customer's Slack workspace and the exact connect error. Confirm whether their Slack admin has 'Require apps from Slack Marketplace' enabled; they must disable it (uncheck 'Only Slack Marketplace apps can be installed') under App Management Settings, then retry.
